episodes.title: Birinci Bölüm
episodes.summary: Kuzey and Güney, like two opposing directions on the compass, are two different brothers in their characters and dreams. Guney is calm and calculated while Kuzey is wild and spontaneous. The only thing they have in common, apart from their commitment to each other, is that they have dreams that are too big to fit into the simit bakery run by their father, Sami. Kuzey wants to go into the military and become a military officer, while Güney wants to get into a good university and study towards a lucrative career in finance. When Cemre and her mother Gülten move to the neighborhood, a new chapter opens in the lives of Kuzey and Güney. The two brother become close friends with her and the threesome begin to discover love. Gülten, who does not approve of her daughter's bond with the Tekinoğlu Family, has different dreams about Cemre's future. Handan, who has gotten used to her unhappy and loveless marriage with Sami over the years, has all her dreams pinned on her older son, Güney. One day before Güney's university exams, just when Kuzey decides to declare his love for Cemre, he discovers that his brother, Güney, has just started a relationship with her. Hiding his love, trying to calm the pains of a broken heart, he quarrels with his dad and ends up drinking at a bar with his pal Ali. When Güney goes to drive him back home, he ends up driving into a passerby and killing him. Kuzey takes on the blame and goes to prison.Four years later Kuzey returns a hardened and hurt man, to a family who feels guilt every time they see him. Meanwhile Güney is working hard at his studies and working at a posh exclusive club getting close to the Sinaner family. He is in a steady relationship with Cemre but Banu Sinaner has her eyes on him and takes every opportunity to get close to him.

episodes.title: Kuzey, Hayatı üzerine Kumar Oynuyor
episodes.summary: Although he has regained his freedom, Kuzey realizes that he will never be able to continue his life from where he left off. He acknowledges his brother's relationship with Cemre but silently suffers. He tries to follow his military dreams but he is refused because of a serious injury he suffered while in prison.Kuzey ends up fighting in illegal boxing matches to make some money. Güney worries over the danger he is putting his life into but every word out of Kuzey's mouth and every look on his face triggers Güney's guilty conscience over allowing his younger brother take the blame and punishment for the driving accident.Gülten, who does not approve of her daughter's relationship with Güney is even more worried with the return of Kuzey because she is one of the few who happens to know he too loves her daughter.While Banu tries to get closer to Güney, Cemre begins quarrelling over Banu's constant presence beside Güney. Güney dismisses Cemre's complaints assuring her that he only has eyes for her.Gülten visits the Tekinoglu house for the first time with her daughter for celebration of Sami and Handan's wedding anniversary! Cemre is upset as Güney has to attend Atilla Sinaner's invitation at the last moment and does not arrive for the dinner. Cemre convinces Kuzey, who is about to go to another boxing match, to take her with him. Güney finds out and follows them there. While Kuzey is in top shape with Cemre close by, Ali shocks Cemre with his revelation.

episodes.title: Cemre Yüzünden Bütün Dengeler Bozuluyor
episodes.summary: Cemre is shocked by what she learned from Ali. While Güney bickers with Cemre over why she accompanied Kuzey to the match, Cemre explains her actions saying she wanted to keep an eye on Kuzey. Kuzey relishes his win but his happinees does not last. The family of the young man who died in Güney's accident comes blasting to the store next day screaming and calling him murderer. Güney takes them away; Kuzey realizes that while he was in prison, his brother has become close friends with the family that regards him as the murderer of their son.Learning that Banu will be in the golf tournament that Güney will attend in Antalya, Cemre convinces Güney to take her with him. He insists that he is going for work but finally agrees to take her. Feeling guilty over the episode with the family of the accident victim, he also invites Kuzey who says he will only go if Ali goes too. To Handan, this trip seems to be an opportunity to melt the ice between his sons.Güney's absence gnaws at Cemre's patience until finally seeing him with Banu at some point, makes her lose it. Kuzey is there to stop her from falling apart but Cemre's reaction surprises everyone including herself.

episodes.title: Güney'in Sırrı Gün Yüzüne çıkıyor
episodes.summary: Kuzey and Cemre experience an inexplicable moment when a tantrum on one side and Kuzey's loving-kindness on the other trigger feelings that Cemre is not even aware of. While Kuzey hides his amazement with his anger, Cemre sees the only way to get rid of the embarrassment she feels is to run away. Kuzey follows her to put her mind at rest and try to patch things between her and Güney until finally Güney arrives to take over. Güney finds a way to solve the crisis. The sudden decision of Güney and Cemre to bring their marriage date forward affects both Kuzey and Banu differently.Atilla Sinaner, who does not want to leave her daughter's future to chance, takes action to drive Banu away from Güney. When everything is about to go right, Kuzey's little group of friends disrupt the Sinaner ceremony embarrassing Güney. Kuzey leaves early and apologizes to his brother.In another boxing match Kuzey gets a glimpse of Ferhat, a prison inmate he blames for his stabbing in prison. He disappears but Kuzey is determined to find him and settle old accounts. Later, while Kuzey and Güney are working at the bakery Güney ends up inadvertently revealing the secret of the Tekinoğlu Family to Cemre.

episodes.title: Cemre, Güney'den Uzaklaşıyor
episodes.summary: Cemre, who learns that Kuzey has been in prison for years instead of Güney, is shocked. She decides that she doesn't really know the man she intends to share her life with. Güney, who is afraid of losing Cemre, turns his anger towards Kuzey. Kuzey packs and leaves. He calls Cemre to keep her from breaking up with Güney. This effort brings Cemre closer to Kuzey. On the streets he is approached by the mother of the accident victim and cursed and abused by her. distraught he ends up drinking in an old hide out only to be found by Cemre. Banu tries to use the opportunity to get closer to Güney When Kuzey, Güney and Cemre's paths cross again, there is a new reckoning about the past.

episodes.title: Kuzey'in ölümle Oyunu
episodes.summary: Güney's utterance of his suspicion that Kuzey is in love with Cemre is an affront to Kuzey's sense of brotherly loyalty. Kuzey leaves the couple. Güney tells Cemre they should separate so she has time to think and make sure she can accept him in view of her new discoveries.Banu immediately takes action and asks for help from her half-brother Barış to completely remove Cemre from Güney's life. Kuzey has more immediate problems to solve. Güney regrets not being more understanding to his brother and decides to help him in his own way. Kuzey gets another glimpse of Ferhat his tormentor in prison and goes after him as Ferhat has stolen his money while he was in prison. His search for Ferhat brings him close to death and leads to a shocking discovery.

episodes.title: Banu, Cemre'yi Güney'den uzaklaştırıyor
episodes.summary: Kuzey has to return to the hospital and Sami realizes how he has been played by Ferhat. When he takes action to close accounts with Ferhat, he feels Kuzey get close to him for the first time in years. On the other hand, Banu's plans to drive Cemre away from Güney are beginning to yield fruit. Cemre is chosen as the new advertising face of Sinaner Group of Companies. Unaware of Banu's role in her getting the job, Cemre enjoys this success with her mother Gülten. Kuzey's illness brings the Tekinoğlu Family together as it used to be. As Banu and Simay take their place around the table, the only person left out of the picture is Cemre. Banu even sees the engagement of her stepbrother Barış Hakmen as an opportunity to be close to Güney and her family. Everyone has a different plan on the engagement night of Barış and Venus. On the same night, a press release is made for the commercial that Cemre will play. As Cemre draws attention to herself, she becomes a clear target of Venus. Kuzey's effort to protect Cemre will not be enough. No one will be able to prevent what will happen that night.

episodes.title: Kuzey'in önüne büyük bir engel daha çıkıyor
episodes.summary: The paths of Güney and Cemre, which intersect at Sinaner Mansion in the morning, reveal the events of the engagement night with all its nakedness. While Güney and Cemre are at one end of this confrontation, Banu and Barış are at the other end.On the other hand, Kuzey, unaware that he is borrowing from Güney, uses the money he and Ali have as the first capital of his new business. Even this first step gives Kuzey a completely different energy. He is more confident and hopeful now.It doesn't take long for Gülten to learn what happened in the Sinaner mansion. She confronts them to break all ties with Güney and his family. Kuzey, who wants to celebrate his new job with his family, learns what happened between Güney and Cemre. Kuzey, who buried his love for Cemre in his heart years ago, forces Güney to make up for his mistake. On the other hand, Banu also uses her father to strengthen her new situation with Güney. On the first day that Kuzey started his new job with hope, he will find another obstacle in front of his future that he never anticipated.

episodes.title: Kuzey, Ferhat'ın Tuzağına Düşüyor
episodes.summary: Ferhat resorts to a different way to prove his power to Kuzey and goes after Cemre. Ferhat is using Cemre as he did in the past in prison to force Kuzey to fight for him. Cemre is confused and shocked not knowing what kind of game she is part of. Learning of the existence of a man following her daughter, Gülten revisits her past.Kuzey is focussed only working and paying off his debt to Güney. He gets excited over the new job Ali suggests to him. He is a hit as a cosmetics salesman but his excitement is short lived. Meanwhile he doesn't know how he is being lured into Simay's plans for her future.Gülten, who wants to know the real reason why Cemre was not featured in the commercial, does not give up. The sudden visit of Cemre and Gülten to the Sinaner Group of Companies creates an unexpected crises.Continuing to bother Cemre, Ferhat finally reaches his goal. Kuzey, who learns everything from Cemre, goes mad with anger and demands a meeting right away leaving Cemre confused and worried.

episodes.title: Kuzey Güney 10.bölüm
episodes.summary: Kuzey meets Ferhat and realizes he has to bow to his demand in order to protect his loved ones. The mention of Cemre's name in Ferhat's note to Kuzey brings Güney's suspicions to light again. Cemre informs Ali about the events and once more Güney realizes his mistake. Together with Güney they take the matter to Sami Tekinoğlu, who calls Ferhat and demands that Kuzey return. Everyone awaits his return with concern. Gülten wants the Tekinoğlus to leave her family at peace. She rolls up her sleeves to create a new job opportunity for her daughter. On the Sinaner family side, the tension between Banu and Barış that started because of Venus continues to escalate affecting Attila's health. Cemre returns Kuzey's case and closes the chapter with Güney. Announcing her pregnancy to Kuzey, Simay sees Kuzey as her only chance for her future, whereas Kuzey is a man who has no future anymore. Ferhat has activated his agreement with Kuzey.

episodes.title: Kuzey Kör Dövüşü Yapıyor
episodes.summary: Simay tells Kuzey she is pregnant hoping that he would marry her so she won't have to go back to Mersin to her parents. Kuzey asks her for some time and tells her not to worry that he will think of something. Kuzey's immediate concern is surviving the fight he is facing at night. While Atilla Sinaner struggles to survive in the hospital after a heart attack, Banu blames Barış for the situation. Barış in the meantime tries to save his own future in anticipation of Attila's death.With Kazım coming to their house to see his daughter, Gülten cannot keep Cemre out of the events any longer. On the other hand, Gülten's efforts yield results. Cemre starts working at Katmanoğlu Holding. After Atilla's death, Banu and Barış's mother, Ebru comes to Istanbul. With the return of Ebru, all the balances suddenly change. This new period will also affect Banu and Güney from the very first moment.Simay aborts the baby. Having survived the blind fight, Kuzey spends a day thinking about the situation. He finally buys a ring and goes to Simay and proposes marriage accepting responsibility for the baby. Simay accepts hinding the abortion. Kuzey wants the marriage to remain a secret until he can get his finances in order. The day he signs the wedding book, Kuzey meets Zeynep, who will change his life completely over time.

episodes.title: Kuzey, Kazım'la Karşı Karşıya
episodes.summary: Simay wants Kuzey to take her to Mersin and face her parents. Ebru who has decided to settle in Istanbul, will closely monitor her children's lives. Now, Barış's relationship with Venus and Banu's relationship with Güney will have to be approved by Ebru. Zeynep's arrival in the neighborhood brings a new excitement to Ali's life. However, this excitement leaves its place to disappointment when Zeynep starts to take an interest in Kuzey.Seeing her father in front of her unexpectedly, Cemre is forced to talk to Kazım at her insistence. Cemre's short meeting with Kazım reaches a whole new dimension when Kuzey gets involved. This leads to Cemre and Kuzey sharing their secrets and becoming one another's confidants. . Güney has to pass Ebru's test by starting a venture from scratch. Kuzey faces Simay's family in mersin. After Kuzey and Simay announce that they were married, her father shoots at them. Simay throws herself in front of Kuzey to shield him.

episodes.title: Güney, Kuzey'i ateşin içine atıyor
episodes.summary: Simay's injury causes the truth about the pregnancy to come to light. Kuzey, shocked by Simay's deception regarding the baby, decides to divorce Simay as soon as he returns to Istanbul. However, realizing Simay, churned by her family, has  no one, he feels responsible for her well being. So he decides to maintain the marriage but tells her that it will only be on paper and not a real relationship.The tension between Sami and Güney, which has been going on for a while, escalates again when Güney asks his father for financial help in his new venture. Kuzey sets his mind to settle his 20 thousand lira debt to his brother right away so he can invest in the project. For this he makes a deal with Ferhat.Kuzey's deal cleans the slate for his father and gets his brother the money he needs. Güney's interference with Kuzey's plans, thinking he too is doing his brother a favour, will however throw Kuzey into the fire.

episodes.title: Kuzey Güney gerilimi
episodes.summary: The raid, which started when Güney reported Ferhat to the police, grows even more with the deepening of the investigations. Events change color. But the only thing Kuzey cares about is to convince Ferhat that he is not the one who broke his promise. Kuzey takes the money back from Güney to return it to Ferhat. But it is too late. Seeing the video of himself setting fire to Ferhat's property, Sami realizes that Kuzey's acquiescence to Ferhat was also to protect his father. The gap between the two brothers is getting wider. As Kuzey hits an obstacle with every step he takes, Güney's luck is gradually increasing.The answer Banu and Güney expect from abroad for their new job comes. Güney is determined to use this situation as an opportunity for his brother. On the other hand, Zeynep is seriously interested in Kuzey and he cannot deny his attraction but tries to remain aloof in view of the circumstances. Cemre, who understands Kuzey better day by day and gets closer to him, is beginning to discover him in her own heart. Despite Kuzey's efforts to hide his marriage to Simay from everyone, the truth emerges unexpectedly.

episodes.title: Gizli evlilik Tekinoğlu Ailesi'ni karıştırıyor
episodes.summary: With the emergence of Kuzey's secret marriage, the Tekinoğlu family gets involved again. While Handan Hanım is appalled, Sami is more accepting. Now Kuzey has to struggle with both his own family and Simay's family separately. Concerned for Simay's life, he moves her into Ali's home and prevents her uncle from finding her. In this process, Kuzey receives support from a place he never expected.New information about Atilla Sinaner's will does not sit well with Ebru. Ebru pursues the truth that could cause a crisis between her children Banu and Barış. On the other hand, Güney and Banu cling to their new project. As Güney approaches his goals step by step, this new job gradually begins to take an important place in the life of Kuzey. Despite the confused situation he has fallen into, Kuzey can't hide his interest in Zeynep. Cemre is the only person who notices this difference in Kuzey's demeanor in a bitter way. Zeynep does not hesitate to take the first step and reveals her feeling to Kuzey. Kuzey is moved but the surprise waiting for both of them will unexpectedly end their rapprochement.

episodes.title: Zeynep, Kuzey'e öfkeli
episodes.summary: Zeynep, who thinks that Kuzey is secretly hiding her marriage from her, is angry with Kuzey. Sami's bringing Simay home, unaware of everyone, affects everyone at home adversely. Zeynep is embarrassed that she opened up her feelings to Kuzey and she is angry with Kuzey for leading her on. She also calls Cemre and reproaches her for not telling her but Cemre explains the details of the situation. Simay tries to rebuild her relationship with Kuzey riding the support of Sami but Kuzey reminds her at every turn that he can never accept her. Simay looks for ways to secure her own future with Kuzey. In the difficult days of Kuzey, Cemre is still closest to him, but Kuzey's attraction toward Zeynep will hurt Cemre the most. Güney, to ease his conscience towards Kuzey, insist on his partnership in his project with Banu. Kuzey gets involved and takes his responsibilities seriously. On the other hand, the ongoing crisis between Banu and Barış changes direction with Ebru's move.Handan Hanım clearly reveals her dislike of Simay and looks for ways to send Simay out of the house. Simay also makes it clear to her that this is going to be a bitter fight. At the company's party before the New Year, Güney organizes an event to promote the new product. Kuzey is also involved in this organization. Kuzey and Zeynep come together for the first time, days later, at that party.

episodes.title: Kuzey, Simay'dan Boşanmak Istiyor
episodes.summary: Kuzey and Zeynep's kiss is witnessed by Simay, Cemre and Güney. Simay keeps quiet and waits her time. Kuzey hates being misunderstood by Zeynep. The fact that Zeynep becomes more and more important in Kuzey's life hurts Cemre inside. The war that started between Handan and Simay intensifies when Simay goes against Handan at every opportunity. The tension that started in the Tekinoğlu Family reaches a point of no return.The New Year's Eve celebration, which started quietly at Ali's house, turns into a lively event with surprises throughout the night. After the night at the Sinaner group of companies, Zeynep meets Kuzey for the first time here. However, this time Simay, as Kuzey's wife, is also there and they have nowhere to run. Kuzey's efforts to express himself to Zeynep takes place in front of Cemre. Simay, on the other hand, finds a way to remind him of her existence at every opportunity. Handan's departure creates a crisis at home and when Güney blurts out Kuzey's kiss in front of Simay, she puts on the injured act and steps into a new plan. Kuzey dismisses her reaction and reminds her that he does not feel in any way tied to her and as soon as her situation with her family is resolved they will divorce.Thinking he is about to get rid of his yoke, he calls and tells Zeynep that he will soon be free and ready to start anew with her. While Kuzey dreams of a brand new beginning with Zeynep, Simay decides to play her last card.

episodes.title: Kuzey'le Simay'ın Düğünü Var
episodes.summary: Simay tricks Kuzey and secures his place in the house. Kuzey is once again forced to live a life he does not want. Zeynep blames herself for the suicide attempt. On the other hand, Handan Hanım, who had to return to Istanbul quietly, realizes that in her absence, Simay has increased her power at home.The rumours about Kuzey and Zeynep leads to a confrontation between Sami and Hüseyin. When Gülten does not remain silent about the injustices done to Kuzey, the events escalate.Zeynep clings to her job to get away from Kuzey. However, the new year gift that Cemre gets for Kuzey ends up bringing Kuzey closer to Zeynep. In the midst of all that has happened, Cemre struggles with her emerging feelings towards Kuzey. Gülten is the first to notice the storm inside her daughter.Simay forces Kuzey to have a wedding. The wedding will be held in Mersin. Cemre and Ali go with them to not leave Kuzey alone. Kuzey cannot down the ceremony without getting drunk. Cemre and Ali are constantly by his side to prevent a fiasco. Cemre finds herself falling deeply in love with Kuzey as he elapses into drunken self pity over his unfortunate fate. Cemre's eyes will reveal the truth to hidden eyes.

episodes.title: Banu ile Cemre arasındaki soğuk savaş şiddetleniyor
episodes.summary: Left alone with her feelings, Cemre becomes more and more certain of her love for Kuzey. Güney, who realizes Cemre's feelings for Kuzey, is struck by jealousy and finds himself making a pass at her. Cemre  however teaches Güney a lesson that he never expected. Simay, who witnesses this moment, also gets a big trump card. On the other hand, Banu learns that Cemre also went to Mersin for Kuzey's wedding, and realizes that Simay had insisted on Cemre's presence. Cemre takes her place on Banu's agenda again. The cold winds between Cemre and Banu are now more intense.On the other hand, important connections are established regarding the Makara business in Istanbul. The company that Güney and Banu founded continues to grow much faster than expected. Simay, who is getting stronger against Kuzey and his family with each passing day, finally confronts Zeynep.On the other hand, Simay has to choose her side in the relationship between Güney and Banu. Annoyed by Simay's attitude, Banu lashes back with a plan that brings Kuzey and Zeynep together for the first time in a long time.

episodes.title: Kuzey Ve Zeynep Başbaşa
episodes.summary: Zeynep snaps at Kuzey accusing him of playing games. Kuzey defends himself. Cemre is the first person to notice Banu's game against Kuzey. With the game she played, Banu managed to hurt Cemre without realizing it, not Simay. This event makes Güney snap at Banu. Realizing that Güney's voice is getting stronger every day, Ebru realizes that it is time to intervene in the relationship between Banu and Güney. Güney, who has noticed Ebru's resistance, finally breaks his silence. Now Güney becomes a clear threat to Ebru and Barış. Realizing what kind of future awaits her in the Tekinoğlu Family, Simay begins to see that her marriage to Kuzey is far from her dreams. In Kuzey's absence, Simay begins to search for new romantic opportunities.Kuzey and Zeynep, on the other hand, are aware that when it is revealed that they went to Antalya together, they will face the reaction of everyone, especially Simay and Hüseyin. Therefore, they are more careful not to get together. But this process does not take long. Getting to know Kuzey more closely, Zeynep moves toward him further showing her attraction. This will finally reveal the truth about the precious present Kuzey has received.

episodes.title: Kuzey, Hüseyin'in Karşısına çıkıyor
episodes.summary: Realizing that Kuzey and Zeynephave gone to Antalya together, Simay's first reaction is to hang up silently. However, it doesn't take long for Zeynep to find out who this silent call came from. While Simay tries to decide what path to follow in his relationship with Kuzey from now on, Zeynep begins to experience the uneasiness of the events that will break out in Istanbul. In these moments, it falls to Kuzey to calm Zeynep. When they return to Istanbul, Kuzey right away goes to Hüseyin to explain the situation. Seeing Kuzey and Zeynep side by side, Hüseyin snaps at Kuzey and accuses Zeynep of deception. Witnessing this moment, Cemre realizes with sadness that the bond between Zeynep and Kuzey is getting stronger. Güney's presence and his success with the Makara business makes Ebru more uneasy with each passing day. She feels it is time to completely remove Güney from Banu's life. According to Barış, Güney's weak point is still Cemre. On the other hand, the effects of Cemre's thoughtful gift for Kuzey begins to unravel causing fluctuating feelings for him. While the cold winds blow between Zeynep and Cemre, Kuzey tries to find answers to the question marks in his head. The celebration dinner that Barış and Can organize for their partner company enables Barış to activate his plans for Güney. While Cemre is the first surprise of the night for everyone, Banu and Güney detonate the real bomb. At the same time, what changes the whole meaning of that night for Cemre will come from Kuzey.

episodes.title: Ali, Simay'ın Yalanlarını Ortaya çıkarıyor
episodes.summary: The call from Kuzey's phone completely changes the meaning of the night for Cemre. Unmoved by news of Banu and Güney ‘s news, she thinks Kuzey has taken a step towards her and she is happy attributing great meaning to this phone call. Meanwhile Ali wants Kuzey to reconsider a relationship with Cemre. Kuzey feels it is an impossibility.In the Sinaner family, the turmoil of Banu and Güney's engagement continues. Ebru and Barış have no intention of accepting this engagement silently.Handan Hanım is most happy when Güney takes the first step towards marriage with Banu. She is eagerly prepared for the dinner organized for the two families to meet. Tekinoğlu Family goes to Sinaner Mansion. That night will be very difficult especially for Güney.On the other hand, Simay learns the secret of Kuzey and Güney. She now has a much stronger trump card to guarantee his place in Kuzey's life. The only person who is aware of Simay's lies is Ali. On the evening when the Tekinoğlu Family and the Sinaner Family are coming together, Ali takes action to expose Simay's lies.

episodes.title: Kuzey, Sümer Hesaplaşıyor
episodes.summary: Concerned about how Kuzey would be affected if he found out about Simay's intrigues, Ali prevents Kuzey from seeing Simay and his beau at the club. While trying to understand what is going on around Kuzey; Ali takes action to completely close the Simay notebook. With the emergence of her relationship with Sumer, Simay has nowhere to run. Trying every way not to lose Kuzey, Simay plays all the trump cards in her hand.On the other hand, the dinner at the Sinaner Mansion is enough to reveal the gap between the Tekinoğlu and Sinaner families. Banu and Güney's efforts to survive the night without any damage are destroyed by Barış's move. At the end of the night, Barış's "marriage contract" surprise shocks the Tekinoğlu Family. In the face of this situation, Güney realizes that he has to make a very critical decision to achieve his goals. Ali, who wants Kuzey to start a brand new life listening to his heart, does his best to steer Kuzey in the right direction. Trying to keep Kuzey out of trouble, Ali confronts Sümer alone. Despite all of his efforts, this showdown will bring Sumer and Kuzey face to face.

episodes.title: Kuzey'in öfkesi Büyük
episodes.summary: Kuzey learns all the facts about Simay. Cemre and Ali are concerned Kuzey will do something rash and land himself in prison. Kuzey, however, handles the situation with calm and tells Simay that he is going to start divorce proceedings. While Güney is enjoying his great victory against the Sinaners, losing against Güney makes Barış even more ambitious. On the other hand, Banu's condition is skillfully hidden from Güney. Simay has no intention of leaving the Tekinoğlu family's life easily. She threatens Kuzey with revealing the secrets she knows but Kuzey warns her that such an action would bring out the dragon in him. She decides to try her luck with Güney.Ali tries to prevent Kuzey from meeting with Sumer again, but unfortunately his fears come true. Kuzey once again faces Sumer to protect Ali. While Kuzey tries to clean up the roughness in his life, Güney continues to expand the brand he created and to grow his business. The fact that Banu wants him with her under all conditions makes her stronger. Now he is even closer to his goal. While Kuzey rejoices in the success of the business, Güney feels it is time for his brother to get out of his way.

episodes.title: Kuzey ve Güney yol ayrımında
episodes.summary: Kuzey feels the pain of being stabbed in the back by his brother. In these difficult moments, Ali and Cemre stand by Kuzey. When they are alone with Ali, Kuzey begins to talk for the first time about his experiences and feelings and confesses everything about the night of the accident. Güney's uneasiness grows with each passing minute, as he pushes Kuzey out of the Makara business. After the flowers sent to her, another big and expensive surprise awaits Simay. Simay first suspects Zeynep and later Güney. She even tries getting news from Gülten but cannot figure anything out. On the other hand, Sümer, who is well acquainted with Kuzey after being beaten, finds his own way to take his revenge. Kuzey, who is preparing to open a brand new, clean page in his life, comes face to face with Güney for the last time. When two brothers are alone at a crucial crossroads, Güney must make the most important decision of his life.

episodes.title: Kuzey Ve Güney Arasındaki Tüm Bağlar Kopuyor
episodes.summary: The accident set up breaks all ties between Güney and Kuzey. While Kuzey suffers in disappointment that he was right, Güney is angry that he was put to such a test. There is no winner in this game for two brothers.When the two brothers meet again in the morning of that night, the argument between them turns into a fight between two enemies. Güney, with the pain of embarrassment, makes Kuzey make an unspoken oath that will affect his relationship with Cemre.The divorce hearing date of Kuzey and Simay is set. Güney, who does not want to give in to Simay's blackmail, tells everything to Banu by taking a big gamble.On the other hand, Barış continues to look for ways of presenting a new obstacle in the way of Banu and Güney.The trial day comes. Kuzey is waiting for Simay at the courthouse to get a divorce. At the same time, Simay finally meets her "mysterious protector".

episodes.title: Kuzey, Ferhat'ın Peşine Düşüyor
episodes.summary: The message that comes to Kuzey's phone puts Ferhat back in the picture. The message creates the effect Ferhat expects on Kuzey, and Kuzey follows Ferhat. Ferhat, who puts his revenge plan into practice, acts by calculating Kuzey's every step in advance. Kuzey realizes in a short time that with every step he takes without thinking, he is also putting his loved ones in danger.Simay feels forced to cooperate with Ferhat. On the other hand, the conflict that started between Cemre and Zeynep because of Kuzey shows itself more and more. But every step Cemre takes towards Kuzey forces Kuzey closer to Zeynep.Announcing her marriage date to Güney with a sudden decision, Banu gives everyone a big surprise. While Ebru keeps her silence for her daughter's health, Barış takes concrete steps to prevent this marriage.Death of Simay's father provides Ferhat with a new idea to get back at Kuzey. Kuzey knows that the funeral will be a link to Ferhat and sets out for Mersin. Can he survive the deadly trap set for him by his mortal enemy?

episodes.title: Kuzey Ölümle Yüz Yüze
episodes.summary: Kuzey is facing death and only Ali has some clues to possibly save him. Cemre realizes her phone is being used by Ferhat. She warns Güney and gets angry at him for remaining cool. Sami also tries to help his son by contacting Simay's family and trying to pave the way for a respectful meeting between him and the family. Simay realizes Kuzey is on his way. Cemre also contacts Simay to persuade her to help Kuzey against Ferhat. Simay's mother suspects something fishy is going on between her daughter and the shady man accompanying him (Ferhat).On the other hand, Güney is faced with the new fait accompli of Banu. Baris, who learns that Banu put the marriage date forward, rolls up his sleeves to prevent this marriage at all costs. According to Ferhat's plan, Kuzey's life is in the hands of his dear friend Ali. Can Ali best the race against time to save his dear friend's life?

episodes.title: Kuzey için belanın yeni adı Bekir
episodes.summary: Kuzey manages to survive another round of the blind fight. This makes Ferhat even angrier. Simay who has now been rejected by her mother sticks even closer to Ferhat by showing him another trump card.In the cold war between Barış and Güney, a new front opens with the intervention of Sümer Tezkan. Güney learns about the game played on Cemre's warning.Although Kuzey, who hides his experiences in Mersin from Sami, has decided to stay out of trouble, he cannot remain indifferent to the call for help of the shopkeepers in the neighborhood and follows Bekir, who extorts money from the shopkeepers.Handan, who is in a sweet rush when Banu and Güney announce their marriage date, is excited to host the Sinaners at her home.Kuzey's new business idea with Ali further increases the tension between him and Güney. Meanwhile, Ferhat uses his latest discovery about Kuzey to hit back at him. The night Handan Hanım prepares with great effort to host the Sinaners turns into a nightmare with the surprise at the door.

episodes.title: Kuzey'in Simay'la hesaplaşma vakti geliyor
episodes.summary: When the police arrive at the door to reveal the biggest secret of the Tekinoğlu Family, everyone except Barış is in for a shock. Güney who immediately accuses his brother, is taken to the police station. Kuzey goes after Simay knowing she is responsible for spilling the beans. While Güney's detention is widely covered in the press thanks to Barış, Barış uses this great opportunity to get rid of Güney completely. Güney and Handan keep blaming Kuzey but find out Simay is the one who has informed the family of the victim.Zeynep, who learns that Kuzey took the blame for his brother and spent four years in prison, meets another face of Kuzey and is further impressed by him. As the relationship between Kuzey and Zeynep progresses, Cemre gets more injured. Aware of her daughter's pain, Gülten does her best to keep Cemre away from Kuzey.Kuzey, who continues to search for Simay, is kidnapped by unknown men. The sudden disappearance of Kuzey creates a new fear for everyone, especially Ali. But this time Kuzey finds a strong supporter who helps him find Simay.

episodes.title: Simay'I, Kuzey Korkusu Sarıyor
episodes.summary: Simay awaits with fear to see what Kuzey has in mind for her.The investigation into the night of the accident continues. Güney is uneasy that Kuzey does not come to testify in his support. This sets him on the path for revenge. However, Kuzey is actually trying to clean this business from its roots. Kuzey forces Simay to sign the power of attorney for the divorce purposes and takes her to the police to deny the veracity of accusations against Güney.The anger of Güney against Kuzey also harms Sami's business. It is time for Sami to hold Güney accountable. Sami goes to the Holding in his baking apron and makes a scene. When Güney's past is published in the newspapers, the Sinaners also become the topic of the press. Although Banu tries to rectify this situation in her own way by giving an interview, the result turns Güney into "Cinderella Man".Barış has gained another trump card against Güney. He is determined to use it to the fullest. In this process, a new document from Ferhat is very useful. On the other hand, tensions are increasing due to the unspoken rivalry between Cemre and Zeynep. Zeynep reads Cemre's messages on twitter and begins to think that they were written for Kuzey. Cemre also resorts to lies to get rid of this situation. This leads Kuzey to think that Cemre has a lover. Zeynep gets uneasy as she notices Kuzey get upset when Bariş calls on Cemre at night.Kuzey and Zeynep are alone for the first time in Ali's home. Zeynep wants to take their relationship a step further. Cemre arrives and realizes with pain that she is losing Kuzey.

episodes.title: Simay'I Kuzey Korkusu Sariyor 2
episodes.summary: Witnessing that Kuzey and Zeynep's relationship has progressed further, Cemre decides to discreetly put a brake on it. Zeynep, who starts to feel Cemre's presence at every moment of her relationship with Kuzey, begins to feel uneasy with Cemre. The two friends fall apart.Güney gets new information about the fire in the Sinaner mansion and encounters the name "Burak Çatalcalı" for the first time. As Güney completes the missing pieces, he will get closer to the secret of the Sinaner family. Meanwhile Güney's actions gives Venus away and brings Barış to end their engagement.On the other hand, Simay follows the traces of Ferhat's life that she never knew. As Simay succumbs to her curiosity, she begins to tread into dangerous waters.Kuzey agrees to work with Şekip Uncu's company on the condition that he is allowed to produce his own product. Kuzey is aware that with this move, he will be a rival to Güney. He makes several samples for them to try out. Güney feels threatened by Kuzey's move and wants to stop him.On the other hand, the relationship between Kuzey and Zeynep continues unabated. Cemre, who is now silently experiencing the pain of love, begins to enter Barış's field of interest. Cemre realizes he and Can are responsible for the opportunity created for Kuzey and feels grateful to them. However, while everything is going well in Kuzey's life, he is suddenly faced with the dark side of Ferhat.

episodes.title: Simay'ın ifadesi Kuzey'i yakıyor
episodes.summary: Kuzey takes Simay to the hospital without hesitation. However, Simay is afraid of Ferhat's wrath, so she does not implicate Ferhat in her testimony. Kuzey is held at the police station under suspicion of hitting her but she does not file a complaint and so he is released. Ferhat cleans up all evidence of the attack. Kuzey's attempts at reporting Ferhat fail.With Şekip Uncu supporting Kuzey, Güney, who is even more ambitious, has new plans. Meanwhile, the tension between Cemre and Zeynep makes itself felt at every opportunity. Barış is beside Cemre when she goes to the police in support of Kuzey. Barış tells Can that he is interested in Cemre but Can warns him to stay away.  On the other hand, the fact that Barış and Cemre are constantly being mentioned side by side begins to disturb Kuzey more and more.Learning about Sami's thoughts on Kuzey and Zeynep's relationship, Hüseyin begins to fear that this relationship will become more and more serious. He tries to push Zeynep away from Kuzey to no avail.Handan finds solace with Gülten and feels deeply the failure of her marriage. On the other hand, Gülten can no longer remain silent about the pain that Cemre suffers because of her love for Kuzey. The great confrontation between Gülten and Cemre will make the wound in Cemre's heart bleed more. While Kuzey longs for Cemre, Zeynep takes refuge by her side.

episodes.title: Kuzey'in Öfkesi Kabarıyor
episodes.summary: With Zeynep starting to stay at the Gülten's house, Cemre tries to escape the house to avoid hearing about Kuzey and Zeynp's relationship all the time. Kuzey, on the other hand, tries to reconcile Zeynep and his father, but has little success. On the other hand, when Kuzey understands the message Ferhat wants to give him through Simay's photos, Bekir is the only person he can ask for help to protect his loved ones. As Kuzey wants to get rid of the troubles around him, he realizes that he is beginning to owe too much to Bekir.Cemre's escape from the house leads her straight to Barış. The time they spend together allows Barış and Cemre meet sides of each other that they never knew. Kuzey, who thinks that Cemre is having an affair with Barış, makes a great effort not to show his discomfort about this situation.The increase in Güney's questions about Banu's past pushes Ebru to take new measures in this regard. Barış, on the other hand, plays Burak Çatalcalı's trump card to remove Güney from their lives. However, Barış is unaware that he is taking a big gamble on his own future. On the other hand, Güney puts into practice the plan that will make Kuzey's new job dependent on him. When the truth comes out, Kuzey has to make an important decision despite Güney.It is very difficult for Kuzey to see Barış and Cemre together after a difficult day. When Kuzey loses control in front of everyone, this moment only makes Cemre happy. On the other hand, the process that will change the life of Sinaners will begin with the emergence of Burak Çatalcalı.

episodes.title: Kuzey'in Duyguları Tekrar Sınanacak
episodes.summary: While Kuzey's attack on Barış makes Cemre happy inside, it strengthens Zeynep's suspicions about Cemre and Kuzey who goes on to complain to Gülten about it.On the other hand, Kuzey finds a trace of Ferhat's past thanks to Bekir. Simay is held in captivity by Ferhat and she is too scared to even run away.With the appearance of Burak Çatalcalı, Banu completely loses herself. Güney, who is chasing the missing pieces, obtains an important information thanks to Cemre. Barış, on the other hand, is not even aware of the storm he has started.On the other hand, Cemre, who realizes that Kuzey is jealous of Barış decides to further establish his jealousy. She organizes a nice party for her birthday in which Barış and Kuzey are also invited. She organizes a party on the beach, just like in the old days. Back in his room, Kuzey cannot come to terms with his feelings for Cemre.

episodes.title: Kuzey, Cemre'ye özel bir hediye veriyor
episodes.summary: Baris, who learns all the facts about Burak Çatalcalı from Ebru, realizes that he has followed the wrong path to separate Banu and Güney. When Güney, who has a great trump card against Barış, reveals what he knows, Barış is cornered. When Barış takes action to send Burak from Istanbul, it will be too late.Cemre's birthday plans do not go as she wanted from the first minute. To hide her disappointment, Cemre sends out a party call to anyone who wants to join them. Many people come but Ferhat also gets the message and decides to make his presence felt in the party.On the other hand, Emral, who came to Istanbul to fix the relationship between Zeynep and Hüseyin, wants to meet Kuzey without wasting any time. Kuzey meets Zeynep's mother before going to Cemre's birthday and realizes he is being put to a test. Every question Emral poses to Kuzey underlines the chasm between Zeynep and Kuzey once again. Kuzey leaves Zeynep with her parents and goes to get a gift and go to the party.Kuzey gets Cemre a compass necklace to show her the north (Kuzey) whenever she's lost ! Cemre is deeply touched by the gift and asks him to put it on her. Just when Zeynep is about to join them, Kuzey connects the cake with Ferhat and shields Cemre just in time. Kuzey disappears from amongst his friends and loved ones to figure out a way to handle Ferhat's threats.

episodes.title: Kuzey Ferhat'ı suçlayabileceği bir delil buluyor
episodes.summary: Learning that Şermin Koflu is alive, Kuzey begins to gather the evidence that could put Ferhat behind bars. But first, he must reach Şermin Koflu. Ferhat, on the other hand, becomes more dangerous when Şermin, the biggest reason for his hostility with Kuzey, comes to the fore again.On the side of Sinaners, the whole family is mobilized to help Banu recover. On the other hand, with every step, Burak gets closer to the big secret that the Sinaners keep from him.Learning that Kuzey has come home days later, Zeynep wants to spend time with him. Ferhat finds a way to intrude into their meeting and Kuzey snaps and wants her to stay away from him. Zeynep is upset. Kuzey realizes again that the only way to protect his loved ones is to stay away from them until Ferhat leaves their lives. Desperately looking for the right solution, Kuzey finally goes to the prosecutor's office to file a complaint against Ferhat. On the other hand, Zeynep begins to question her relationship with Kuzey. Despite her love for Kuzey, Cemre tries to help Zeynep understand him. Barış, on the other hand, keeps trying to get closer to Cemre. Kuzey finally finds a way to reach Şermin Koflu but Ferhat is ready with his counterattack.

episodes.title: Kuzey gizlenmek zorunda kalıyor
episodes.summary: Kuzey realizes he is too close to Şermin Koflu and must continue his pursuit so he tries to avoid the police and a possible arrest.Pressure of meeting Burak again finally makes Banu snap causing Güney to reconsider his decision to marry her.Kuzey has to hide from both Ferhat and the police. During this time, Bekir is his only chance. For Güney, who begins to question his life, Cemre is still an unhealed wound. The person he takes refuge in his loneliness and desperation becomes Cemre again.Kuzey uses all the means at his disposal to send Ferhat to prison. However, Ferhat has a response for every move. Kuzey attends the launching ceremony of new Makara business after days of slipping the police but he has to skip the event with the appearance of the police.

episodes.title: Güney ile Banu evleniyor
episodes.summary: When Kuzey finds out who the person who saved him from the cops at the last moment is, first this name means nothing to him. Burak Çatalcali is not able to get help from Kuzey but learns something about Kuzey's character.Güney is left to deal with the reproach of the Sinaners because of the scandal at the opening.Kuzey realizes that he will not be able to settle the issue with Ferhat by running away from the police. But when he appears before the judge, when he finds it difficult to control his anger, the decision puts the Tekinoğlu Family in a difficult situation again. However, Ali, despite preparations for their wedding with Demet, finds a way to solve Kuzey's problem. Meanwhile, Simay finds a way to delay the divorce further irritating Kuzey's nerves.Due to what happened at the opening, the Uncu Family cuts the bill to Güney. Güney, who had to fight on different fronts because of Kuzey, finally lashes out. Witnessing this moment of Güney, Cemre learns that she is the secret hero of the "night of the accident". This fact brings Kuzey, Güney and Cemre together to face it.While Banu and Güney's wedding night is overshadowed by the surprise of the uninvited guest, Kuzey gets an important opportunity to get rid of Ferhat with an unexpected call.

episodes.title: Birinci Sezon Finali
episodes.summary: Kuzey manages to put Ferhat in police custody. Kuzey is happy after the fearful and dark days of looking over his shoulder all the time. But Koflu reproaches him for involving the police rather then killing her. Ferhat, on the other hand, starts dressing up his testimony to get out of prison.The Burak Çatalcalı crisis, which started at the wedding of Banu and Güney, grows bigger with each passing hour. Banu gets a wind of Cemre's presence in Güney's apartment before the wedding and throws a tantrum going overboard. Cemre is angry with Kuzey having called him a coward for his silence. Cemre finally decides to completely close her ears to the voice of her heart.But just as Kuzey is beginning to take a sigh of relief and go back to life with people he loves, Ferhat deals him a dreadful blow.

episodes.title: Kuzey sevdiğiyle vedalaşır
episodes.summary: The bullet fired by Ferhat changes Kuzey's whole life. With that bullet, Kuzey's childhood ends.Kuzey has worked hard to set up financial support for Demet, Ali's family and his own parents. Now he is ready to take revenge at all costs.Güney is considering divorce while Banu pleads with him to forgive her. Zeynep returns from Italy after a long stretch and is mad at Kuzey and Cemre for hiding their love from her.Eluding Turkish police headed by Commissioner Şeref who is also tailing Ferhat, Kuzey wants to mete out Ferhat's punishment with his own hands. This is the first time he's been this close to his revenge. He intends to kill Ferhat at the cost of his own life. Before confronting his enemy, he says goodbye to his beloved.

episodes.title: Ferhat, Simay'ın ölüm emrini vermiştir
episodes.summary: Knowing that Kuzey will only confess his love "on the way to death", Cemre realizes that he has come to the end of the dangerous road. Cemre desperately asks Güney for help to reach Kuzey. While Sami anxiously awaits the news of his son, Güney is shaken by the fact that the secret bond between Kuzey and Cemre is put into words.On the other hand, Zeynep, who thinks that Kuzey and Cemre are using her, surrenders to her anger. From now on, she will be one of the obstacles in the way of Kuzey and Cemre. When Kuzey and Cemre meet, Cemre says she is ready to keep silent about their love but instead wants him to forego the revenge and remain alive. Kuzey cannot bear the weight of his friend's loss.Simay's statement to the police turns into very important information with Kuzey's help. However, Ferhat has already given the order for Simay's death. Knowing that Simay is his only chance to reach Ferhat, Kuzey has to make a very dangerous choice to keep Simay alive.

episodes.title: Güney Kuzey'i tehdit ediyor
episodes.summary: Tension grows in the Tekinoğlu family when Kuzey brings Simay, whose life is threatened by Ferhat, home. Being under the same roof with Simay is unacceptable for Handan, but Handan is not helpless this time. She takes refuge with Güney.This time, Kuzey and Güney confront each other because of Simay. Güney threatens Kuzey with cutting off financial support for Demet and Ali's family. Kuzey dares him to do it.Meanwhile Zeynep secures a job in the Katmanoglu Holding as a prelude to what appears to be a revenge plot. Cemre does not appreciate Zeynep's secretive moves.Knowing that Kuzey and Cemre will never be together, Gülten decides to support Barış to build a comfortable future for her daughter. The cold war between Zeynep and Cemre gains a new dimension. Unaware of her mother's plans for her, Cemre is determined not to give up hope on Kuzey. While the cooperation of Commissioner Şeref and Kuzey continues, Simay's clue will untie a big knot, and direct Kuzey to find a way to get Ferhat out of his hiding place.

episodes.title: Kuzey, Ferhat'ın kızı Deniz'in peşine düşer
episodes.summary: The arrival of Ferhat's daughter in Istanbul activates Kuzey's plan. Despite the agreement he made with Commissioner Şeref, Kuzey follows Deniz and connects with her.The cold war between the Sinaners and Burak Çatalcalı gains a new dimension with Burak's unexpected move. On the other hand, Handan's stay in Sinaner's mansion extends when Sami cuts all ties.Güney's jealousy toward the ever revealing bond between Kuzey and Cemre makes him consistently lash out at his brother. The weak bond between the two brothers is completely broken with Güney's blocking of the money to Demet and Ali's family.Şeref has to agree to cooperate with Kuzey regarding Deniz.Gülten's support for Cemre is an important starting point for Barış. Barış starts to appear more confident in front of Cemre. However, all of Cemre's attention is on Kuzey.The accidental appearance of Kuzey at Banu's birthday party gives Zeynep an opportunity to hurt Cemre. Cemre does not believe Zeynep.Ferhat learns that his daughter is in Istanbul. Kuzey finally succeeds in catching Ferhat's attention and the comeback begins at that moment.

episodes.title: Kuzey yine bir kavşaktadır
episodes.summary: Kuzey approaches Deniz to get Ferhat out of his hiding place. He has to lie to gain her trust. Even though this situation is very difficult for Kuzey, he has to be patient as he approaches his goal.Cemre does not believe that Kuzey is with another woman and thinks that Zeynep is lying to hurt her, but at the same time, the suspicion begins to gnaw at her heart. After a sleepless night, Cemre confronts Zeynep. Thinking that Kuzey is a big obstacle for Cemre's future, Gülten talks directly with Kuzey. She asks him to get out of the way and let Cemre get on with her life and marry Barış. This speech, made without Cemre's knowledge, tears Kuzey's heart. With the threat of Ferhat still in his life, he has nothing to offer Gülten as a response to the happiness and security of her daughter's life with himself. On the other hand, Ferhat, who learns that his daughter is in the hands of Kuzey, gets to Kuzey with a stern move.Kuzey is again at a crossroads. As the plan for Ferhat is reaching fruition, Kuzey finds himself caught up in Gülten's wish to make Cemre give up on their love.

episodes.title: Kuzey Nikaha engel olabilir?
episodes.summary: Kuzey cannot stop to clear Cemre's misunderstanding. Thinking he is with another woman, Cemre decides to remove him from her life completely. She will marry Barış. When Gülten gets the news, she makes an effort not to make Cemre think too much about the reason behind this decision. She supports and pressures her to marry Barış as soon as possible. Cemre thinks she has seen Kuzey's disloyalty with her own eyes. She should completely erase him from her life. When Kuzey learns that Cemre will marry Barış, he knows that he is the reason for this decision. Cemre is on the verge of leaving his life. Zeynep jealously watches Kuzey suffer because of Cemre and secretly clears the obstacles for Cemre's marriage to Barış. The Sinaners, whose agenda suddenly changes when they learn about Cemre and Barış's decision to marry, do not take Barış's decision seriously at first. While they think that Barış will not attempt such nonsense, they learn about the secret wedding. Güney lashes out at Kuzey for letting Cemre marry Barış. Kuzey's attempts at reaching Cemre are averted first by Gülten and ultimately by Zeynep.

episodes.title: Kuzey Ferhat'la karşı karşıya geliyor
episodes.summary: Zeynep's plan works. Everyone goes to the wrong address and neither Kuzey nor the others can prevent Cemre's marriage. Cemre waits until the last minute with her eyes on the door hoping against all odds that Kuzey would arrive but she finally seals her marriage with her signature. Cemre is now Barış's wife. Kuzey wants to take his anger out on Güney. There is no relief for Kuzey. He tries to take his pain out by throwing his fists around. Güney immediately asks Zeynep to account. Zeynep brushes him away.Ebru is determined to make Barış pay for his mistake and instructs lawyers if Barış continues to stay married to Cemre, he will lose everything he has and taken to court for forging Attila's signature. On the other hand, Cemre is devastated when she learns that Kuzey came to the wedding hall to prevent her.As Kuzey tries to cope with the pain of losing Cemre, Ferhat sends a message through Simay's mother. Ferhat will have to meet Kuzey on his terms since he can threaten him with Deniz. Ferhat, on the other hand, takes measures to strengthen his hand. Kuzey, eludes the police and finally faces Ferhat but can he find relief by taking his revenge.

episodes.title: Cemre evliliği bitirmek istiyor
episodes.summary: Kuzey choses to forego his revenge and protect Cemre. Someone from behind the trees shoots and kills Ferhat.Kuzey, who had sworn to kill Ferhat with his own hands, is angry he could not honour his oath. As suspects multiply during the investigation, the case begins to get more and more complicated. Commissioner Şeref finds himself compelled to resign over the fiasco of having been given the slip by Kuzey. With Ferhat's death, Kuzey still continues to be bombarded by threats. Blaming him for her mother's death, Simay vows to turn his life into a nightmare.Cemre, who is now completely sure of Kuzey's love, is aware of what a mistake she made by marrying Barış. Determined to recover from her mistake, Cemre tells Kuzey that she will end this marriage, but is unaware of the new traps being set for them.When Cemre talks to Barış and says she wants to leave, she has to make a choice that will change the course of her life. With the discovery of Sami Tekinoğlu, the course of the murder investigation changes. Sami thinks Güney is the one who protected his brother by killing Ferhat.

episodes.title: Kuzey her şeyi tamamen terk etme kararı alıyor
episodes.summary: The secret behind Ferhat's death brings Kuzey and Güney face to face again. Thanks to Simay Barış now realizes Cemre is actually in love with Kuzey and responds to Cemre's wish to divorce by threatening Kuzey's freedom. Cemre, who has no choice but to bow to Barış's threats, makes a short-term deal with him. Cemre, who thinks that she will overcome the barrier of Barış with this agreement, is not aware that she is actually signing a bigger yoke.Kuzey, who learns about Cemre's decision to move to the mansion with Barış, is unaware of the deal she made. In front of her eyes, Cemre is making plans for her marriage and preparing to spend her honeymoon in Paris. Even Gülten, who suspects that there are other reasons behind her daughter's sudden decision to return to Barış, gets rid of all her doubts when she learns that she is involved in this honeymoon trip. She forces herself to believe that her daughter is truly happy.Sami gets closer to Kuzey during his days in the hospital, Sami, who is aware of the pain that Kuzey suffers because of Cemre, offers him a way out. Kuzey should go abroad, he suggests. Although Kuzey rejects this offer, citing his father's health and job, after the last crisis he experiences because of Güney, he decides to leave everything behind.Kuzey's attempts at bringing his parents together are to no avail.Days later, Sami comes out of the hospital. Cemre is in Paris with her husband and news of it is all over the papers. The day that Cemre returns from her honeymoon, she learns from Demet that Kuzey will leave the next day, but Barış forbids Cemre from going to Kuzey. Kuzey does not know that Cemre has returned from their honeymoon. During his last night at home, Kuzey has an emotional and intimate conversation with his father. In the morning, as he is about to leave he has a surprise visitor.

episodes.title: Gülten, Kuzey'den özür diler
episodes.summary: As Kuzey is about to set off for his new life, Gülten stops him. Although she does not want to interfere in Kuzey's life, she thinks that only Kuzey will put an end to Cemre's unhappiness. Gülten apologizes to Kuzey, admitting that she prevented Cemre and Kuzey from being together. Kuzey has to make a difficult choice again. Knowing that the deal they made with Cemre is in danger until Kuzey is completely out of their lives, Barış clearly shows how far he can go to intimidate Cemre.Güney is happy that Kuzey is leaving. Zeynep, who  is blatantly trying to get back at Cemre, continues to try finding new ways to hurt her. Zeynep's new weapon against Cemre and the Sinaners is Simay. Thinking that she will lose Kuzey forever, Cemre takes action, risking everything, despite Barış. she sets out to go with Kuzey.

episodes.title: Simay, Güney'e şantaj yapıyor
episodes.summary: Kuzey confesses his love and for the first time articulates his feelings for Cemre and himself, but he also explains that Cemre's past relationship with Güney makes it impossible for them to be together and he is afraid that it would lead him to break her heart or crush him under its weight. Having no choice but to accept Kuzey's reasons, Cemre quietly submits to her captivity in the Sinaner Mansion. Güney, who takes a sigh of relief with Kuzey's departure, becomes even more irritable with his return.Cemre (obligated) and the rest of the family celebrate news of Banu's pregnancy. Kuzey watches the mansion from the street with longing. Burak arrives to join the gathering and before entering the house informs Kuzey that he is to become an uncle soon. After the party, Burak quietly returns to the mansion to execute a plan in the dark.Burak consistently draws Can's suspicions which he regularly shares with Barış. Cemre is relieved that Barış is keeping his end of deal and not demanding any intimacy from her in their relationship as long as appearances are kept. Güney finds the envelope addressed to him with a glove inside.Kuzey ends up drowning his pain in the bottle at a club and wakes up on a strange woman's couch not remembering the exact details of how he got there. He leaves apologizing to the woman but she thanks him for having prevented her ex-boyfriend from bothering her. Kuzey returns to her car dealership later to thank her for letting him sleep at her place the night. She ends up offering him a job. While he considers it with his father, Güney once more puts him down.Knowing that Kuzey has nothing left to lose, Sami is aware that his son is now more reckless. He goes to Gülten and warns her to refrain from trying to influence Kuzey regarding his relationship with Cemre. He wants the two brothers to reconcile and feels Cemre is an obstacle. Gülten visits Cemre and is concerned for her well being. She shares her concern in passing with Kuzey. Kuzey confronts Barış but Barış manages to avert Kuzey's suspicions by forcing Cemre to confess to remaining married to him of her own will.Zeynep, who wants to win Kuzey back, pursues dangerous plans. She connects with Simay and tries to create a scandal without revealing her signature on it. Simay, taking her cue from Zeynep and thinking Kuzey is out of the country, blackmails Güney. Güney informs Kuzey and Kuzey lashes out at Simay. Güney softens the blow by paying Simay behind Kuzey's back. He then accuses Kuzey of remaining in Istanbul because he cannot get over Cemre. Simay hears the quarrel and once again makes plans to stir things up. She lets Zeynep know that Cemre took action to escape with Kuzey. Zeynep immediately shares the information with Banu. Banu is confused about Cemre's relationship with his brother.Burak arrives to the meeting at the Holding together with Kuzey as his advisor making a stir. He puts his hand on the table with the other glove on.

episodes.title: Cemre çaresizce yeni hayatına tutunmaya çalışır
episodes.summary: Güney lashes out at Burak regarding the glove and Kuzey also takes Burak to account as he is unaware of the glove issue. Kuzey announces to everyone that he will be close to Sinaners until he finds answers to the question marks in his mind. While Güney, Kuzey and Burak are dealing with the crisis, Barış and Ebru Sinaner are making plans to save the future of the company behind closed doors. The financial situation of the company is not as shown to the partners. This plan, known only to Ebru and Barış, needs to be realized before the public offering.After their conversation with Kuzey, Cemre desperately tries to hold on to her new life to no avail. Zeynep, on the other hand, finds a way to get closer to Kuzey using his birthday as an excuse. Kuzey says he does not want to attend any celebration. Zeynep not only draws everyone's compliments with the birthday present she prepares for Kuzey's, she also uses this situation to hurt Cemre. Kuzey appreciates the present but will not respond to Zeynep's advances. In the meantime, Cemre manages to hold herself from calling Kuzey to wish him happy birthday.Barış stays in Turkey one night without everyone's knowledge and meets with Melda Yalgın representative of a foreign company that provide services to sinking companies. Behind closed doors with Barış Hakmen, Melda Yalgin plays a leading role in taking very important decisions that will affect the future of the Sinaner Group of Companies. The short-term agreement she will make secretly with the Sinaners will change in time with Güney's involvement in the events.Barış's delay, other than his mother only known by Can, makes Can uncomfortable making things more suspicious with the news of Burak's near death car accident.

episodes.title: Kuzey sevdiği kadına karşı zırhlarını indiriyor
episodes.summary: While Burak Çatalcalı is struggling to survive after his accident, the evidence found in his car makes him the number one suspect in Ferhat's murder. This makes the ongoing investigation take on a new dimension. Şeref follows the trail even though he has resigned from the force. Question marks take Şeref to the Sinaner Mansion. Şeref's visit causes havoc in the mansion. Banu is now sure that there is a situation that her mother and brother are hiding from her. She also snaps at Handan. Handan in turn for the first time sees some truth in Kuzey's view of his brother as a lackey to the Sinaners.Meanwhile, Venus, receiving the news of the accident, knocks on Kuzey's door for help. The information that Burak shared with Venus before his accident throws a new light on Burak's accident. Kuzey involves Şeref and now they know financial matters are not as they seem at Sinaner Holding. Venus shares her concerns with Zeynep as well. Zeynep immediately takes the news to Banu.Cemre, on the other hand, is patiently waiting for the day when her deal with Barış will come to an end, away from the events around her. She begins working at the office again and is happily surprised to find Kuzey there. Zeynep arrives and seeing Cemre there tries to create intimate scenes with Kuzey right away. Later Kuzey notices Cemre and takes his leave from Zeynep discreetly to go after Cemre. Cemre stands at the edge desperate with pain. Another surprise pulls her away from the edge.

episodes.title: Cemre Kuzeye yardım etmek için kolları sıvar
episodes.summary: Kuzey can no longer hold back. Cemre's pain arrests him and he has to take him in his arms. The two heroes of impossible love have a magical moment  from which Kuzey leaves silently. Witnessing this moment, Zeynep's wound deepens. Her anger and jealousy make Zeynep increasingly dangerous. She first tells Banu about what she has heard about the financial problems of the company. Ebru finally has to include Banu in their secret urging her not to tell Güney. Conversations behind closed doors make Güney realize that his place in Sinaners' life is shaky. Meanwhile Kuzey is trying to expose the irregularity in the company but can't make head or tail of the documents. The help Kuzey needs comes from an unexpected person.Cemre, who thinks that she will be freed if Barış's dirty tricks are revealed, also rolls up her sleeves to help Kuzey. Although Kuzey opposes this for Cemre's safety, he knows that he cannot stop her. Cemre is caught red handed while Kuzey arrives at their door concerned for her safety.

episodes.title: Zeynep hırsına yenik düşer
episodes.summary: With Kuzey at the door, Barış has to control his anger against Cemre but manages to silence her with his threats. Zeynep's enby takes the better of her and she does what she had tried to get Simay to do herself. However, the flames of the fire that Zeynep starts affect Sinaners the most. When all the secrets of the past are revealed, the calm air in the mansion suddenly leaves its place to a storm. Banu, who directs all her anger towards Cemre, has a miscarriage. Zeynep's revenge game brings Kuzey and Güney into a head on collision and the Simay ends up having to pay for the damage.Kuzey throws Simay out of the apartment and then goes on to finally find the solution he is looking for to expose the dirty tricks of the Sinaners. Meanwhile, Ebru Sinaner has to make big concessions to make the deal that will save herself and her family from a difficult situation. When Kuzey takes action against the Sinaners, Güney unknowingly gets involved in his brother's plan exposing the Sinaners.

episodes.title: Handan için köşkte rüzgar terse esmektedir
episodes.summary: Kuzey shares his victory against the Sinaners with his father. Güney uses a simple but effective weapon to drive the Kuzey away from the Sinaners. After all their plans are ruined, Sinaners are at a dead end. They have no choice but to hold on to Güney's plan to get out of the situation they are in. Güney turns the crisis into an opportunity to consolidate his place in the mansion with a masterful move. However, for Handan, the wind blows in the opposite direction in the mansion. When Handan realizes that she has been sacrificed even by Güney, she realizes the only person to take shelter with is Kuzey. Kuzey takes his mother to his apartment and later discreetly tries to see if his father is prepared to make another go at his marriage. Sami snaps at him and is fully taken by Aynur. Kuzey doesn't have the heart to tell Handan. Güney throws it at her face and tells her that she should return to the mansion with him.While everyone continues to blame Simay for being responsible for the news in the newspaper, Cemre is sure that Zeynep is behind this incident. She does her best to make Kuzey to see the truth. Zeynep is tortured by her conscience and escapes Kuzey's sttempts to tak to her. But she is finally caught and Kuzey realizes it was all her doing which she admits to doing because she hates him.After the magical moment they lived on the terrace of the company, Cemre is hurt by Kuzey's escape from her, but she enters the new year by holding on to this moment. Kuzey is about to get rid of the biggest burden on his back, Simay. However, the new year is preparing the biggest change for Handan.

episodes.title: Handan Aynurla yuzlesiyor
episodes.summary: Thanks to the power of attorney given by Burak Çatalcalı, no one will be able to keep Kuzey away from the company. When she sees Kuzey for the first time in days, the new year begins for Cemre at that moment. Cemre, who clings to her dreams after Kuzey's divorce from Simay, looks forward to the day when her marriage to Barış will end. Cemre feels that this year will be the "year of love" despite all the obstacles that stand in their way.After saving the Sinaners from the brink of the abyss, Güney is intoxicated with victory. In this process, he does not notice Banu's deteriorating psychology. Banu finds a way to be alone with Cemre and invites Cemre to the boat, and they set sail. When Cemre realizes that they are alone on the boat, they are far from the shore. Banu manages to make Cemre jittery but also giver her an excuse to stay with her mother for a few days.Kuzey, unaware of everything, goes to Trabzon with Demet to visit Ali's mother, who fell ill. Şeref declares his feelings for Demet to her just before they leave. Demet is weighed down by the revelation. In the house where Ali was born and raised, Kuzey once more feels the deep pain of loss even more as he is mistaken by Ali's aging mother as Ali himself.On the other hand, Handan visits Aynur and gives her an account of the Sami she has come to know over the years and warns her against marrying him. Aynur is shocked to see the dark side of Sami and ends her relationship with him leaving him distraught. Sami confronts Handan and they both manage to hurt each other. Handan decides to leave Kuzey apologizing in a letter for not being a more protective mother for him.Neither the success he has achieved in the Company nor the fact that Burak Çatalcalı is the number one suspect in Ferhat's murder will allow Güney to breathe a sigh of relief. When his secret is discovered by Banu, Güney succumbs to the most despicable solution to silence her.

episodes.title: İki kardeş arasına yeni düğümler atılır
episodes.summary: Kuzey is shocked by Banu's condition when he arrives at the mansion but continues to feel the weight of Banu's revelation to him the night before. Still he asks his father to provide support for his brother. Sami brings Güney home and warns Kuzey to refrain from confrontations. Güney puts on a convincing show. Kuzey tries to connect with his father but Sami is upset over his fall out with Aynur.Zeynep follows the clues to Simay and gets Can Katmanoglu to take her to Simay's workplace.Güney makes sure no one can influence the course of Banu's "treatment" other than himself. Sami wants his two sons to take this opportunity to get close again but what he overhears at Güney's door makes him uncomfortable.Demet shares her feelings for Şeref with Cemre and then meets him to tell him nothing can develop between them.Kuzey gets an unexpected moment on Skype with Cemre and once more impresses on Cemre that she cannot expect a future with him. Cemre is unperturbed knowing his words are a result of Güney's canker on Kuzey's conscience rather a lack of love. But right away, Zeynep arrives at his door in the middle of the night to drop a bomb.

episodes.title: Barış, Cemre'yle yaptıkları anlaşmayı bozmak üzeredir
episodes.summary: Kuzey goes to the address Zeynep gives him and cannot turn his back on Simay. He feels responsible for what has happened to her and wants her out of there. However, Kuzey's well-intentioned efforts to help her brings to light an old enemy more troubles for both of them. When Cemre learns what happened, she is uneasy about Zeynep trying all ways to maintain her bond with Kuzey.Ebru Sinaner, who regrets leaving Banu alone in the past, is determined not to make the same mistake for the second time. Ebru's decision to bring Banu home unsettles Güney. Returning to the company, Burak begins throwing suspicion on Barış.Cemre has a surprise run in with Kuzey at Simay's apartment. The magic of the moments they spend alone with Kuzey does not last long. Barış calls and makes Cemre uncomfortable. Kuzey who senses it right away, is not one to stand for secret meetings with a married woman and wants to leave.Melda tells Güney about the oil stain on Barış's sleeve and Güney tries to get Cemre to find the shirt but lands her in more trouble with Barış. Barış is beginning to demand more from their marriage. Kuzey tries to talk with Banu to no avail. Simay has to save herself from rape.

episodes.title: Barış karanlık yüzünü gösterecek
episodes.summary: Cemre is faced with the dark side of Barış, shortly before the end of her marriage. Barış tests what Cemre will give up in order to keep Kuzey out of prison. While Cemre is counting the days for the end of her torture, she has no one to take shelter with except Kuzey. Despite the distance between them, she finds a way to connect to him. This love becomes the target of the hatred of Barış after Güney. On the other hand, when Zeynep comes face to face with Kuzey, she snaps and throws at him all she has piled up inside against him and his love for Cemre. Zeynep remains bitter and bent on revenge. Realizing that Kuzey will follow him until the real killer is revealed, Güney draws all the attention to Barış. Burak implements his plans to strengthen his claims.Handan return to the mansion to take care of Banu. Hearing about developments between Sami and Aynur, she tries to get information through Zeynep.After Simay tells Şeref that she has killed Mori Şevki, the police cannot find the traces of the scene she describes. Meanwhile Şevki remains alive and well. Şeref makes the connection between Simay's boss and Kuzey and realizes Kuzey is the target. He hides keeping Simay at his home and tries to solve the situation on his own. His secretiveness makes Kuzey think he has a girlfriend at his home. Kuzey also arrives at Şevki's den and hell breaks loose.Kuzey's misunderstanding about Şeref creates an unexpected effect on the relationship between Şeref and Demet. After Sami Bey, encouraged by Gülten settles his problems with Aynur Hanım, it's time to introduce Kuzey to his new family. On this day when rings will be worn within the family, Kuzey is wounded by the betrayal of his closest friends.

episodes.title: Kuzey, bir kez daha demirparmaklıklar ardına
episodes.summary: Kuzey will not forgive Şeref and Demet. The day Sami wears a ring with Aynur, when Kuzey learns that Şeref is hiding other things, he completely loses control. On the other hand, with the influence of Güney, Barış, who thinks that Cemre is collaborating with his enemies, breaks the agreement with Cemre and files a complaint against Kuzey to the prosecutor's office. Cemre cannot stop Barış so she tries to find Kuzey.Cemre finds Kuzey at Ali's grave. Kuzey feels beaten by the people he trusted and mourns once more losing his loyal friend Ali. Cemre arrives and tries to persuade Kuzey to escape. When Kuzey learns about Barış's threats to Cemre, he does what he has to do and surrenders to the police. On the other hand, suspecting that there is someone who wants to kill him, Burak Çatalcalı soon becomes sure of his suspicions. The person who is after Burak will add a new one to the unknowns of Ferhat's murder. Cemre is in pursuit of her compass when the iron bars separate Cemre and Kuzey once again. Just before being locked up, Kuzey finds a way to give Barış a taste of what he has in mind for him for what he has done to Cemre.

episodes.title: Kuzeye üç mektup
episodes.summary: Although the appearance of someone confessing to killing Ferhat changes the course of the case file, it does not immediately clear Kuzey. Burak Çatalcalı and Commissioner Şeref are still in pursuit of the real killer. The murder suspect's statement reminds Şeref of a past story.On the other hand, Güney is relieved for a short time with this surprise confession. It is easier to convince Banu now. However, as his forbidden relationship with Melda draws attention, Güney faces a new danger.Kuzey has fallen back into the nightmare he lived in years ago. He strives not to repeat the same mistakes. On visiting day, Sami and Handan meet in front of their son for the first time in a long time. Handan learns about Sami's wedding date as he informs Kuzey.Cemre and Zeynep no longer hide the tension between them. Aynur becomes an unexpected audience to their enmity.Sami brings three letters for Kuzey. Kuzey tears up one of the letters without even reading it; reads one and puts it away, reads the third over and over again.Cemre is confronted with the unexpected news of her father's passing. Simay's attempts at connecting with Güney puts her in Barış's way. Sending Kuzey behind bars, Barış realizes that his own freedom is under threat by an anonymous mail sent to the mansion. However, Kuzey will give Barış the real shock.

episodes.title: Cemre, Barış'ın karşısına çıkar
episodes.summary: Kuzey puts the compass necklace back on Cemre's neck. Barış punishes Cemre for this with invoking the exorbitant divorce conditions Cemre has signed up on unawares in the prenuptial agreement.  Sami gathers everyone at home in the evening to celebrate Kuzey's release. Burak drops in on them as well, impressing on Kuzey that he still suspects Barış of tampering with his car and planting the weapon in his car. Deniz drops on Kuzey unexpectedly.Barış spends more time with Simay and she begins to feel he has sincere feelings to toward her.With Ferhat's case gradually closing, Güney begins to relax.
