For Banu, it is the last days of captivity. Banu presents a good camouflage for Güney's new project with Melda. Sami Bey's wedding day comes. Handan drops in at the wedding to give her best wishes.

episodes.title: Zeynep'le Cemre arasındaki gerginlik büyüyor
episodes.summary: Handan cannot believe that her husband has so quickly gotten over their marriage. Handan's arrival makes everyone uncomfortable. Kuzey, who intervenes in the situation, does not leave his mother alone in this difficult day. Kuzey is affected Handan's sense of betrayal. Handan makes him reflect on how he feels betrayed by Demet and compare it to his mother's feelings.Sami sets out with his new wife to make a family visit. Cihan is entrusted to Kuzey. Zeynep uses this situation to get closer to Kuzey fomenting greater tension with Cemre.Güney's plan to be alone with Melda on Valentine's Day, is ruined by Banu's surprise. Ebru Sinaner who discovers the infidelity of her son-in law puts an end to the relationship. Melda has to leave and convince Güney her priority had always been the success of her business projects.Sami is affected by her ex-wife's presence at his wedding. Aynur handles his crisis with patience.Gülten, who wants to save Cemre from the shackles of Barış, is trying to secure a loan at the bank. Witnessing Gülten's desperation, Kuzey learns about the agreement that ties Cemre's hands. He has to prevent himself from the urge to go and take it out on Barış. Instead he has to go and collect Cemre and Demet from the bar where Cemre is drowning her troubles in cocktail glasses.

episodes.title: Cemre Barış'a boyun eğmek zorunda kalır
episodes.summary: The photographs of Kuzey and Cemre in the newspaper bring Ebru Sinaner and Barış to Cemre's home. With guarantees provided by Ebru Sinaner that this will be her last task, Cemre agrees to make a last appearance beside Barış in front of the media.Güney feels all his life is a lie. He reveals to his mother how he envies Kuzey and all that he has. Banu overhears that her marriage to Güney is a big lie. Realizing that no matter what happens, Kuzey cannot break away from Cemre, Sami finally breaks his silence and tells Kuzey to go after his heart and disregard any gossip that it might create.Şeref finally finds a way to express himself to Kuzey and resolve the problems haunting his friendship with Kuzey and love for Demet.On the day that the Sinaner group of companies is listed on the stock market, a big show takes place in front of the cameras, starring Cemre and Barış. The press release draws attention to Cemre and Kuzey once again. Thinking that she has fulfilled her last duty, which is the condition of an agreement, Cemre and Kuzey are caught unaware one more time by the journalists.Simay's mind is still on Barış. Seeing him on TV with Cemre makes Simay feel foolish for having thought Barış had any serious intentions about their relationship. Barış who is looking for a way to get Cemre back, finds the latest photograph of Cemre and Kuzey an excuse to call Cemre and threaten her with breaking the deal. Cemre is mad and decides to go to him and take him to task. She will regret this impulsive decision as it unravels the most difficult days for Kuzey and Cemre.

episodes.title: Cemre tutuklanıyor
episodes.summary: Cemre is caught with the crime weapon in her hand and taken into custody by the police as the sole responsible for what happened. Gülten and Kuzey are in for a shock when they learn about the incident in the middle of the night. They can't believe what happened. However, even Cemre cannot explain what really happened on that night that ended in a disaster. She is only sure of the existence of a "third person" in the guesthouse. Kuzey follows the clues, but only Güney reaches "the person" that Cemre mentioned before anyone else. Ebru Sinaner is both sad and very angry. Now anyone who harms his family will be punished. Güney realizes that it will be his turn after Cemre. Cemre is denied bail and arrested in the preliminary court. Kuzey and Gülten are distraught.Knowing how much his brother is suffering, Güney confronts Kuzey at his weakest moment and pretends that he is supporting him. He gives Kuzey permission to go ahead and live his love with Cemre but then omits his observations from the attack scene and then keeps Simay away from the investigation. While Kuzey is trying to prove Cemre's innocence, he is also looking for ways to see her. In the end, Kuzey's efforts pay off. Special permission is obtained for visitation in prison. Cemre is waiting behind the bars with the excitement of this meeting. Kuzey and Cemre come face to face in the visitor's room for the first time in days.

episodes.title: Handan, Kuzey'le ilk kez yüzleşir
episodes.summary: After longing days, Kuzey and Cemre try to fit everything that hasn't been said so far in the short meeting in the prison. Kuzey can tell Cemre now that the only obstacle between them is the "iron bars" and not Güney. Knowing that they will be together at the end of this separation is now Cemre's only consolation. Barış's statement makes Cemre's situation even more difficult. On the other hand, Güney puts together the pieces about the night of the incident and realizes that the third person in the house was Simay. He makes sure no one hears about this and tells Simay to leave.Handan is concerned that her two sons have been torn apart because of Cemre and asks Kuzey to let go of her. Kuzey breaks his silence for the first time and tells Handan he is willing to follow Cemre even if means jumping from cliff.Deniz enters the scene once more to help Kuzey and Barış finds himself forced to change his testimony. While Kuzey is looking for ways to save Cemre from prison, Simay gives him an unexpected visit.

episodes.title: Kuzey ve Cemre için zorlu bir sınav daha
episodes.summary: Simay's clues confuse Kuzey, but he feels glimmer of hope for Cemre's freedom. When Kuzey shares what he learns from Simay with Güney and his brother takes advantage of everything to pretend that he is fixing everything with the Sinanaers.Güney, who learns about the bargain between Barış and Deniz, and uses it to fit his own plans. Güney realizes that Cemre is going to be released despite all his efforts. He changes his plans and decides if Cemre is to be released from prison, it must be on his terms. Acting as "ambassador" between the Sinaners and Kuzey, Güney tells Kuzey Barış will change his testimony if he promises to leave Istanbul and Cemre's life. Accoirndg to Güney, Cemre's freedom now depends on Kuzey.Cemre suddenly gets sick in prison and comes face to face with death. Learning that Cemre has been taken into surgery, Gülten and Kuzey experience great panic. Kuzey, finally reaches important information about the "third person" in the mansion. Kuzey and Şeref separately pursue Simay. Guney, who thinks that he has secured his place in both the mansion and the company forever, is unaware of the danger that awaits him. When the iron bars between Kuzey and Cemre, are removed, their love faces another difficult test.

episodes.title: Cemre Kuzey'e sesini duyurmaya kararlıdır
episodes.summary: Cemre is released and shocked that Kuzey is not there to meet her. Cemre tries to find reasons for Kuzey's departure. The only person who suspects that Güney is playing a trick is again Cemre. Güney is intent on ending their relationship. He tries to convince Cemre that Kuzey's reason for leaving is that he does not have the courage to stand by his love for her. However, Cemre is determined to find Kuzey.Having discovered Güney's true face, Banu is determined to end his games and her marriage. She finally corners Güney. But Güney will not give up easily.Cemre refuses to give up on Kuzey and tries every way to reach him. The help that will take Cemre to Kuzey comes from a place she never expected. Cemre will prove once again that she will never give up on Kuzey.

episodes.title: Kuzey ve Cemre baş başa
episodes.summary: Kuzey and Cemre enjoy being alone, away from everyone and all their troubles. Cemre is determined to remove every obstacle between herself and Kuzey. Now is the time to enjoy being alone, away from everyone and all troubles.Defeated by Barış's move, Güney becomes even more dangerous and ruthless. He enlists Simay to take his revenge on Barış.When he realizes Cemre has gone to Kuzey, Güney goes crazy and once more tries to make them feel guilty by falsely accusing them of being responsible for his troubles with the Sinaners. Kuzey is upset but Cemre suspects that Güney might be lying.Handan appeals to Sami to help Güney whom she claims is suffering all his troubles because of Kuzey.Cemre tries to put her feelings for Kuzey into words. While Kuzey also reveals the depth of his feelings for her, he admits he still needs to resolve his knot with his brother.Simay, who is trying to get her life together, she learns that Şeref is after her and panics. She seeks refuge at the wrong door. Thinking he is responsible for his brother's misfortunes, Kuzey calls Banu to appeal to her and stress his brother's good intentions. Banu reveals to him that Güney has lied to him and in fact, Barış had put no condition on changing his testimony regarding Cemre. Kuzey goes back to take Güney to task.

episodes.title: Güney'in maskesi düşmüş
episodes.summary: Kuzey confronts his brother at his father's in the presence of Sami and Şeref. Güney goes on to spin his tale about Sinaners and how he has done everything to protect Kuzey. Kuzey does not believe him but he knows that he has bring everything to light.Banu, who begins to erase all traces of Güney's life in her life, finds out she is pregnant. She plans to keep the child without letting on to Güney. Simay testifies against Bariş and Kuzey is mad that he allowed Cemre suffer in prison for nothing. Simay settles in with Güney.Kuzey feels every twisted story around him somehow leads to Güney. Güney on the other hand will not give up and keeps painting a picture that makes Kuzey look like the backstabber causing trouble for his bigger brother at every move. comes face to face with Güney once again. They reckon. Kuzey explodes and Güney once more hits him with his harshest weapon telling him he will never be together with Cemre. Kuzey leaves the house in anger and goes to Cemre in the middle of the night. Cemre wakes up to the sound of a hasty hand hitting her window. When she open the door, he says, let's get married.

episodes.title: Kuzey'in evlenme teklifi
episodes.summary: Cemre refuses Kuzey. She wants him to make the decision in peace, not in anger. She encourages him to go to Samson and think things over.Kuzey sets out to finish what he started for the Makara business. Cemre also begin to look for work. A new partnership is established with Zeynep's surprise offer.Witnessing with her eyes that the conflict between her two sons has turned into a great enmity, Handan asks Sami for help. However, Güney's greed for revenge destroys everyone who gets in his way. Güney, who has nothing to lose after breaking his ties with the Sinaners, is determined to revenge himself on everyone. He also secures a gun.Aynur is beginning to feel Sami's temper and her gentle nature is upset over his behaviour. Zeynep and Cemre take on the engagement ceremony of Demet and Şeref as their first project in their new partnership. Kuzey arrives and Dmeet wants him to does the ring exchange. Kuzey carries out the ceremony and walks out. Ali is on Kuzey's mind. He experiences sadness and happiness at the same time. The only person with whom he shares his sadness is Cemre. Kuzey and Cemre approach each other with sadness and longing. Late for the engagement, Güney is faced with a similar scene to the one Kuzey had seen years ago. But he does not plan to give up and turn away silently from it like his brother had done.

episodes.title: Güney her an patlamaya hazır
episodes.summary: Güney has Kuzey and Cemre at the barrel of his gun. His anger is very strong. Zeynep inadvertently arrives in time to prevent Güney's madness. Güney goes and sits at the table and manages to wound Kuzey as usual with the bitter poison of his tongue.Realizing that Güney is a bomb ready to explode at any moment, Şeref takes precautions to prevent bad events. His eyes are always on him.While Güney carries out his plans to finish the Sinaners and imprison Barış, Kuzey takes steps to establish his new life by trying not to think about Güney.On the other hand, a letter from Deniz will distract all his attention. Deniz gives Kuzey a clue to Ferhat's murderer with a letter he sent.As Cemre's birthday approaches, Kuzey prepares another gift for Cemre that she will never forget.

episodes.title: Handan Hanım sonunda yumuşar
episodes.summary: Kuzey has now made his decision and bought the engagement rings to propose to Cemre. This time he has to prove to Cemre that he took this decision not out of anger towards Güney, but simply to continue his life with her.Having completed the first part of his plan, Güney has done the Sinaners the damage he wanted for now. He retreats to his corner and silently waits for the counterattack.Cemre speaks with Handan of her love for Kuzey. Realizing that Cemre and Kuzey will not give up on each other no matter what, Handan finally softens. She talks to Gülten to show her goodwill. Meanwhile, she slips something out of his mouth that she should never have said. Cemre has great expectations when she learns through the grapevine that Kuzey has bought a ring. But Kuzey will mislead everyone with his plans.Barış loses all control after the disasters he caused to his family and life. In order to prevent the collapse they experienced, he goes to Güney's house, risking everything. Güney is prepared for his visit with another devious plan. The argument that starts between the two gradually intensifies and ends with an exploding gun.Meanwhile Kuzey unravel his surprise for Cemre step by step and proposes to Cemre in an unforgettable night.

episodes.title: Güney'in planı bozulur
episodes.summary: Barış's escape from the scene makes the story Güney has concocted about the shooting more believable. Simay also corroborates his version of the events. Güney milks his situation to continue wounding Kuzey's conscience. When he sees the rings on Kuzey and Cemre's fingers he pours out his bitter words about how they are enjoying themselves while he is grappling with life and death because of their deeds.Kuzey realizes Simay is living with Güney. Simay supports Güney in every way including judgment of Kuzey as an ingrate. Bariş on the other hand goes to the police with his version of the story and manages to remain out on bail pending the court hearing. Kuzey believes his brother's version of the story while Bariş thinks Kuzey is also in on the trap being set for him.Commissioner Şeref's suspicions about Güney continue. Güney is aware that Şeref has him under surveillance. Sami inadvertently informs Güney of the contents of Deniz's letter which Güney immediately recognizes and manages to remove all the evidence against himself before Şeref gets his hands on it.Cemre realizes how Kuzey is once more being weighed down by the weight his bother has been laying on his conscience. She tells him she wants to lighten that weight a little by returning the ring. Kuzey stops her and tells her he will not go back on his decision so they go ahead with their wedding preparations.

episodes.title: Barış için yolun sonu yaklaşmaktadır
episodes.summary: Güney takes the evidence out of Deniz's hiding place and he is aware that Inspector Şeref is after him. He destroys the self incriminating evidence and only takes to the police the photos that incriminate Barış. Then he tries and succeeds in drawing Kuzey into the game.The marriage preparations of Kuzey and Cemre make Güney even more dangerous. End of the road for Barış is approaching. But he will make one final attempt to revenge himself on Güney.After Cemre and Kuzey's marriage decision, the two families come together for the first time at Gülten's house in the shadow of these events. Fearing that Kuzey will get into trouble because of Güney, Cemre tries to keep him out but Kuzey takes his brother's side and says the attack on Güney is an attack on him and he is not one to leave someone alone under attack.The fact that Güney responds as if he anticipates every move makes Şeref realize he has bugged Simay's phone. He sets up a trap for Güney involving news from Deniz. Güney, who realizes that Deniz is a great danger to him, goes to Kuzey to reach her. He gets Kuzey involved in his search for Deniz. The door that Kuzey will knock on to help his brother will land him in more trouble.

episodes.title: Cemre Güney'le gizlice buluşur
episodes.summary: Şeref tries to open Kuzey's eyes to Güney's lies but Kuzey snaps at him. Kuzey wants to believe there is some goodness in his brother. Güney will take advantage of this.Cemre secretly meets Güney to close the door on the past and asks him to leave her and Kuzey alone to live out their love. Güney is too bitter to be swayed by her. He is determined that Kuzey and Cemre should not marry at any cost.Cemre asks Kuzey to leave off everything and just get married with no ceremony. She is scared that Güney will ruin everything. Kuzey reassures her that nothing will stop them.Kuzey responds to the text send to Güney's phone and becomes a suspect in Sümer's murder.

episodes.title: Kuzey yine kardeşinin arkasında durur
episodes.summary: Kuzey is taken into custody on suspicion of murder. Kuzey's old enmity with Sümer Tezkan once again appears as the most important evidence against him. Cemre will not leave Kuzey's side while Güney tries to scare her off by drawing a picture of Kuzey as a good for nothing who ends up in trouble at every turn.The evidence found at the murder scene suddenly changes the course of the investigation. When the pointer turns to Güney, Kuzey stands behind his brother again. Güney's testimony draws attention to the Sinaner's mansion. When Ebru Sinaner confronts the terrible truth, Barış has long since disappeared. Meanwhile, Barış is not the only person who has not been heard from. Simay is also missing and fighting for life and death in a place that no one can predict. As things get harder for Güney, Kuzey goes to all lengths without hesitation to save him.

episodes.title: Kuzey günler sonra Güney'e ulaşır
episodes.summary: Cemre and Kuzey take a long needed break with Gülten. Handan discovers that Banu is pregnant and calls Kuzey to tell him. Kuzey insists that Güney must be told immediately.Realizing Kuzey and Cemre are not swayed in any way from their path, Güney snaps and takes out his fury on Handan. Meanwhile, he constantly feels the breath of Commissioner Şeref on his neck. He once more secures a gun and begins concocting a plan to prevent Kuzey and Cemre's marriage.Ebru Sinaner, who has lost everything, begins preparations to start a new life abroad with Banu. Banu keeps having visions of Güney destroying her life.Zeynep also makes a plan of her own to overshadow Cemre's happy day. Zeynep's last move infuriates Cemre. She tells Zeynep she is not invited to the wedding.When Cemre opens her eyes to the best day of her life, Kuzey reaches Güney after days and tells him that he still has a chance to save his marriage with Banu with the baby on its way. While Güney is experiencing the biggest shock of his life, Kuzey's eyes opens to the truth.

episodes.title: 80. Bölüm - Final
episodes.summary: Deniz reveals to Kuzey that Güney is Ferhat's murderer. While Cemre is fixing her hair and makeup for the wedding, Kuzey drives around looking for his older brother Güney. Kuzey will make every effort to save Güney from prison and from the darkness he is sinking into. Will Güney reach out for Kuzey's helping hand?
